notes.title: Game Update v1.1 ⚙️
notes.content:
Hello! How are you? How did you start 2023? 🤓

I've been adding some new features to the game, but I also improved and fixed all kind of bugs based on your awesome feedback. Thank you for that! 👌

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41350906/62f7e57de50277e977e1750dc365b78d3ec369b8.gif[/img]

To start, I implemented a special reward for those who unlock all the Steam achievements: as you can see in the GIF above, you will be able to choose your favourite skin for the menus and Tony during the title screen. Once again, the illustrations were made by the great [url=https://twitter.com/viktorahmed]Viktor Ahmed[/url] 🎨


[h2]Volume sound check[/h2]

In terms of gameplay, I added a new sound check: THE VOLUME 🔊

During this transitions, everything goes dark and grey. Music goes down and you can only hear the rhythm kicking in the background.

[url=https://twitter.com/OutOfBoundsVg/status/1615372156912672768][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41350906/c74a69493420516028b0cd5bf7cc6685dca393b2.png[/img][/url]
[list][*] [url=https://twitter.com/OutOfBoundsVg/status/1615372156912672768][i]Watch the video on Twitter[/i][/url][/list]
As happens with the other sound checks (high and low pitches), this new one is triggered randomly and intercalated with the other two.


[h2]Items and more![/h2]

I also improved the visuals for the items in general:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41350906/ec213573abb8b5c400e8e710b986334f8d127e2d.png[/img]


And recreated entirely the Audio assets so they can be more recognizable:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41350906/1b84c1d684b051b454b3e5f0a040b808f8f487f1.png[/img]


I added another 22 languages to the game and also did a lot more changes, you can check the full list at the bottom of this post 📜


[h2]World ranking[/h2]

To close up, here's the official best scores from version 1.0:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41350906/d115f5bd44d8231b07c7c67ee876d98835a77cb9.png[/img]

I have just reset the leaderboards since this new update comes with gameplay changes, so the difficulty has been affected as well.


[h2]What's next?[/h2]

With this update here I want to wrap up Out of Bounds, or at least for now 👍

It was a great experience for me in a lot of aspects, but I need to continue with my other project Tenebris Somnia. Didn't see it yet? Check it out in the link below:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2121510/Tenebris_Somnia/


Thank you once again for all your support. Take care and don't forget to follow me on Twitter!

[url=https://twitter.com/TobiasRusjan][i]Tobías[/i][/url]


----


[h3]Changelog v1.1[/h3]


NEW FEATURES
[list]
[*] Volume Check at the Audio room (randomized together with the other Low and High Pitch Checks
[*] Menu skins as a reward after unlocking all achievements: Dark, Golden, Retro and RGB
[*] 22 new languages: Amharic, Assamese, Bangla, Persian, Gujarati, Hindi, Armenian, Georgian, Khmer, Konkani, Malayalam, Marathi, Nepali, Odia, Punjabi, Sindhi, Sinhala, Tamil, Telugu, Tigrinya, Uyghur and Urdu
[/list]

IMPROVEMENTS
[list]
[*] Assets displayed on the screen (HUD), now also show you if they're being processed; if they're ready to compile, apply or check); and if they need to be fixed
[*] Every time you compile/apply/test or add an asset to a depot, the informative screen from the Mechanics room changes to the current tasks
[*] Increased the energy given by some food: fruits from 5 to 10 and pastry (croissants and donuts) from 10 to 15
[*] Decreased the amount of damage caused by the Ray Tracing of Planys (flying enemies at the Graphics area) from 25 to 20
[*] Added a 250 milliseconds chance to jump when falling off an edge
[*] Moved away the Minor Bugs spawn location from level 3 near to the hot dog
[*] Decreased the volume of some of the sound effects
[*] Visuals of items improved and added new versions to the Audio assets
[*] Visuals from the configuration menus improved and polished
[*] Changed the color of the sound check bar from the HUD based on the type and moved the name to a new pop-up
[*] Adjusted the sound check duration
[/list]

BUG FIXES
[list][*] If you press twice in a row the compile button on the Mechanics room, more Bugs will appear and some of them can't be fixed. Thank you to [url=https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561197991874751]danejerus[/url] for discovering this
[*] If you change the FOV from the video settings, the screen will make a abruct change everytime you enter a new level
[*] Instead of keep attacking, bugs teleport when you're standing in front of them for some time
[*] Test sound bar is being displayed upside down
[*] If the game can't load Steam stats, it starts making frame drops
[*] Instruction screen doesn't have collisions in the first level, allowing you to "out of bounds!"
[/list]

notes.title: 🚨 New game Out of Bounds is NOW AVAILABLE! 🚨
notes.content:
[b]Hello, everybody! How have you been?[/b]

We're doing PRETTY WELL! Closing this crazy 2022 celebrating 🥳

And that's not only because [url=https://edition.cnn.com/2022/12/20/sport/argentina-football-team-arrival-intl-hnk-spt]our football team won the World Cup[/url], but also because we have just released a new game on Steam:

[url=https://youtu.be/U7Q1M-wRbMg][img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4466206/53ceb798e992c68ae96c207c36012d92b474fc5d.png[/img][/url]

Out of Bounds is a peculiar title that was originally created for a game jam the past year ([url=https://itch.io/jam/2021-epic-megajam]Epic Megajam 2021[/url]). As a solo dev, I had 7 days to create a game that was later [url=https://tobiasrusjan.itch.io/out-of-bounds]released for free on Itchio[/url].

Since I liked the result of the jam, I decided to keep working on that idea for the next months and also some great devs (former colleagues from other projects) joined me to get the best results in visuals ([url=https://twitter.com/viktorahmed]Viktor Ahmed[/url] and [url=https://www.instagram.com/scuzzostuff/]Claudio "Scuzzo" Sagrera[/url]) and audio ([url=https://twitter.com/davyd_music]David Levill[/url]) 🙌



[h1]THE GAME[/h1]

Out of Bounds is a title about "creating" a game and "fixing" bugs... Yeah, it's crazy. You will pickup blueprints, compile shaders, test sound effects, drink a lot of coffee. But watch out for the bugs! Grab your Line Tracer and get rid of them 👾

https://youtu.be/U7Q1M-wRbMg
Things are starting to get better here in Saibot Studios and Out of Bounds is part of that process. I'm looking forward to bring you news about bigger projects in the future, but for now give a chance to this crazy puzzle shooter with humor and puzzles 🤓

You can follow Out of Bounds on its new Twitter account:
https://twitter.com/OutOfBoundsVg



[h1]NEWS ABOUT EXPLOSIONS AND GORE?[/h1]

Hell yeah! The people at [url=https://www.humblebundle.com/]Humble Bundle[/url] created [url=https://www.humblebundle.com/games/holiday-encore-best-boomer-shooters-bundle]a new package of retro style first person shooters[/url] based on the one they did in March of this year 🔥

[url=https://www.humblebundle.com/games/holiday-encore-best-boomer-shooters-bundle][img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4466206/d71afde69b8306dbbb108c8e6fbcb9e42f3a60d0.png[/img][/url]

This time, you can get 7 awesome titles for only 12 dollars, including our own [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/753590/Hellbound/]Hellbound[/url] and the great [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1590910/Forgive_Me_Father/]Forgive Me Father[/url] was also added to the list.

A percentage of the sales will go to charity at [url=https://ablegamers.org/]Able Gamers[/url] and [url=https://www.starlight.org/]Starlight Children's Foundation[/url] ❤️

Hurry up! Get the bundle before the next 24 hours ⏲️



If you have a Twitter account, don't forget to follow us for more news:
https://twitter.com/SaibotStudios

Cheers and take care!

[url=https://twitter.com/TobiasRusjan][i]Tobías[/i][/url]

notes.title: 📢 NOW AVAILABLE! 📢
notes.content:
Hello, everybody! How have you been?

Out of Bounds has just been released on Steam in its final form 🙌

Check out the colorful and crazy video we made and published on You Tube:

[url=https://youtu.be/U7Q1M-wRbMg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41350906/73f4c3a4a6606460ec12a19670a8e58c9121ec54.png[/img][/url]


After a whole year in development, the definitive version of Out of Bounds is available for you to play on Steam. After the last demo update, I've been working on a lot of improvements and new content (besides bug fixes, you know...). You can see the full list of changes on the bottom of this post 📜


Besides the game, which you can get from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1787100/Out_of_Bounds/][b]THIS LINK[/b][/url], we also launched a little DLC with the Official Game Soundtrack composed by David Levill:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2221200/Out_of_Bounds_Soundtrack/

Let's "create" that game, guys! Cheers!

[i]Tobías[/i]

----

Changelog v1.0 (since the last demo version):

NEW FEATURES
- Game visuals change with levels
- New enemies Minor Bugs
- New glitch Gimbal Lock
- New 2D animatics with illustrations by Viktor Ahmed
- New soundtracks for each level composed by David Levill
- Steam achievement with status window inside main memu
- Ranking system with current score, own best and top scores

IMPROVEMENTS
- Improved the bugs movement and added a flying feature
- Little FOV change when shooting for a better feedback
- Randomly ordered sound checks in Audio
- Improved visuals of cogwheels in Mechanics
- A popup message appears after finishing all the tasks
- Doors at the Mechanics room open and close at certain moments
- Changed the amount of waves per area: 2 for Mechanics, 1 for Graphics and Audio
- New options to restart current level and start all over
- Using native names for languages
- Added new languages: Azerbaijan, Belarusian, Bosnian, Catalan, Welsh, Estonian, Basque, Filipino, Irish, Scots, Galician, Hausa, Hebrew, Croatian, Indonesian, Igbo, Icelandic, Kazakh, Kyrgyz, Luxembourgish, Lithuanian, Latvian, Maori, Macedonian, Mongolian, Malay, Maltese, Quechua, Kinyarwanda, Slovak, Slovenian, Albanian, Serbian, Sotho, Swahili, Tajik, Turkmen, Tatar, Uzbek, Xhosa, Yoruba and Zulu

BUG FIXES
- Some of the bugs don't appear but the counter persists
- Sometimes, when you open and close the the in-game menu, the game freezes
- Escape key not working during the welcome screen

notes.title: 📦 COLLECTION + SPECIAL VIDEO + MORE! 🪙
notes.content:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/28189/][img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4466206/2baf71e0692653c469784f5518da8d0bd44810da.png[/img][/url]


[h1]Hello there! How are you? How's your 2022 so far? 😎[/h1]

From here, we have a few things to tell you...

As we mentioned you in our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/groups/SaibotStudios/announcements/detail/3123813809682672635]last post[/url], this year we reached an entire decade since we started making games as an independent team in Saibot Studios. But it was just now that we actually make something special to celebrate it. [url=https://youtu.be/S4-E40ce_Oo]Check out the special video![/url]

https://youtu.be/S4-E40ce_Oo

Together with this video, we built and launched a collection with all our published games, including: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/search/?franchise=Doorways]the Doorways saga[/url], [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/753590/Hellbound/]Hellbound[/url] and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1431780/The_Black_Heart/]The Black Heart[/url] 😈

[b]> [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/28189/]LINK TO BUNDLE[/url] <[/b]

Buying the games from the bundle, gives you a 15% of discount on all the titles. And if you already have one or more of the games included in the package, it will discount you the titles you're missing without needing to buy the entire bundle 👌



[h1]TENEBRIS SOMNIA[/h1]

On the other hand, we receently announced our new creation: Tenebris Somnia. This is a very unique title by the great [url=https://es.wikipedia.org/wiki/Andr%C3%A9s_Borghi]Andrés Borghi[/url], creator of The Black Heart 🖤

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2121510/Tenebris_Somnia/][img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4466206/3dc732cee7c111bb33503e507a649dcf3d66ae79.png[/img][/url]

We're developing this project Andrés and I ([url=https://twitter.com/TobiasRusjan]Tobías Rusjan[/url]), together with a great team of artists. You can read more about it and the dev team [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2121510/view/3307354336731266403]in this other post[/url] we did the past week.

If you like the concept of the game, don't forget to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2121510/Tenebris_Somnia/]add it to your Wishlists[/url]. We're aiming to have it ready during 2023 👍

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2121510/Tenebris_Somnia/



[h1]OUT OF BOUNDS[/h1]

In the mean time, I keep working on my little jam game Out of Bounds, a rare title with action, shooting and puzzles. We released a demo in June and it's still available to check directly from the store page:

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1787100/Out_of_Bounds/][img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4466206/53ceb798e992c68ae96c207c36012d92b474fc5d.png[/img][/url]

My idea is finish the full game for the end of the year. [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1787100/Out_of_Bounds/]So play the demo and add it to your wishlist if you liked it![/url] 🙌

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1787100/Out_of_Bounds/



[h1]HELLBOUND... HELLBOUND?[/h1]

This month we received the great news from our (now) former publishers that they're giving us back the IP of Hellbound 🤯

What does this mean?

Finally, we at Saibot Studios are going to start receiving sales from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/753590/Hellbound/]Hellbound[/url] on Steam. Since the release of 2020, all the sales went to the publisher because that was what we stablished: they recoup their investment first, and then we split; but we never reached that last step because they never recoup their part with the sales we had.

But now after two years from the release, they're giving us back the game so we can atleast see some of the sales. Also, we got back the full rights of the project to take any desision we want from now on 🔥

[url=https://youtu.be/ndqIlyYFVJM][img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4466206/5d56edecbe4128de8d9912896496161a814e16f3.png[/img][/url]

In March of this year there was the Best of Boomer Shooters Bundle, the first collection of Humble Bundle focused on retro FPSs. Hellbound had the honour to be included in that package, becoming the first argentinian game in participate in the iconic Humble Bundle:

https://youtu.be/ndqIlyYFVJM

Both the sales from this collection and also the sales from now on (September of 2022) at Steam are going to us at Saibot. Yes, finally!

But unfortunately, this aren't earnings for us yet, since we still need to recoup all we put to create the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/802200/Hellbound_Survival_Mode/]Hellbound: Survival Mode[/url] in 2016-2018.

So the future of Hellbound is still uncertain... The good thing is that everything has started looking brighter now, we'll see how things turn for our Hellgore in the next months 🤞



That would be all for now, people. Hope we have some more news for you soon, follow us in our networks to stay updated:
[list]
[*] [url=https://twitter.com/SaibotStudios]Twitter [/url]
[*] [url=https://www.instagram.com/saibotstudios/]Instagram [/url]
[*] [url=https://www.facebook.com/SaibotStudios]Facebook[/url]
[*] [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCa29sOnJRNG-ZLGU2GfNNow]You Tube[/url]
[/list]

Cheers, everybody! Take care!

[i]Tobias[/i]

notes.title: Demo Update v0.08.25 ⚙️
notes.content:
Hello! How are you? It's been awhile...

During this month of August I've been working full time on the full version of Out of Bounds. And since many of the improvements also applied to the demo, I decided to update it as well here on Steam 🤓👌

Among other stuff, the game now has new and original music composed by the great David Levill, with whom we have been working together for almost a decade...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41350906/ab587b2ee8221e4b46d2dff060b40fff7afc7890.gif[/img]

[i]Tobías[/i]

notes.title: 🎂 10 YEARS OF SAIBOT! 🎉
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4466206/7b810cd997a89e0c3e44b1a3488243164ef329ce.png[/img]



[h1]Hello, people! How are you? How did you started 2022? 🤓[/h1]


In a day like today, but from 2012, we officially started a crazy adventure called [url=http://saibotstudios.com]Saibot[/url] that continues to date.

Actually, the very begginning was in 2011 with the conceptualization and prototype of what ended up being our first title Doorways ([url=https://steamcommunity.com/groups/SaibotStudios/announcements/detail/3039340060183828773]read more[/url]).


But it wasn't until March of 2012 that, after I partened with my Uncle and friend Ivan Rusjan, we finally started working as a team. We built the first Saibot "office", which was actually my room along side the bed and at my Mom's department, and we used some old tables as desks that my Grandma gave us ❤️

And from then, a lot of enechdotes and experiences started hapenning. With tons of fails and drop downs, but also with some wins, we were able to keep going to date doing what we love the most: creating our own games and delivering them all over the world 🌎

So I decided to take some time to build and share with you a quick recap of some of the main milestones we have achieved together with you during the last 10 years of Saibot...



[h1]2012: The Origin[/h1]
[list]
[*] Started the team and office with only two members (picture)

[*] Started the development of the first game and saga: [url=https://doorwaysgame.com/]Doorways[/url]

[*] First public presentation of the game at the event EVA 2012
[/list]

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4466206/d9a7ea9b6833fb127135c0a1ac1a73a9c7a57c20.jpg[/img]

[i]Left: Tobias Rusjan (me), right: Martin Voychisko[/i]



[h1]2013: Prelude[/h1]
[list]
[*] Trip to E3 thanks to a contest we won at Indies Crash E3

[*] Approval of our first game at Steam Greenlight after a lot of [url=https://youtu.be/dg1r_wfViT4]big Youtubers[/url] played it

[*] Official launch of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/248470/Doorways_Prelude/]Doorways: Prelude[/url] on Steam (first argentinian game to be released on Steam after being approved on Greenlight)

[*] Launch of VR (virtual reality) version of Doorways: Prelude with the Oculus Rift Dev Kit 1 (first argentinian game published with VR compatibility)
[/list]

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4466206/7284455e8752bf7471fd8c426f1d49e7950547b9.jpg[/img]

[url=https://youtube.com/watch?v=OI5-LjhxsbE][i]Most popular Youtuber Pew Die Pie playing Doorways: Prelude[/i][/url]



[h1]2014: Underworld[/h1]
[list]
[*] Moved to new home-office with our own space

[*] Team got bigger with 4 full time developers

[*] Development and release of the second game [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/311250/Doorways_The_Underworld/]Doorways: The Underworld[/url]

notes.title: Report: February 2022 🗒️
notes.content:
Hey everybody! How have you been?

Here, I've been working full time on Out of Bounds! And since almost two entire month have passed since the start of this 2022, I wanted to tell you about some of the progress 🤓

First of all, have you seen the [url=https://twitter.com/TobiasRusjan/status/1495890931127574531]new logo[/url]? What are your thoughts? It was designed by [url=https://www.instagram.com/scuzzostuff/]Claudio "Scuzzo" Sagrera[/url], the same talented artist who did our logos for [url=http://saibotstudios.com/]Saibot[/url] and [url=http://hellboundgame.com/]Hellbound[/url].

Alright, let's begin... I'm going to put some images and animated GIFs together with information and also links to posts I did on [url=https://twitter.com/TobiasRusjan]my Twitter account[/url], in case you want to know more about it 👍



[h2]Menus, configurations and guides 📺[/h2]

Let's start with the "boring part", a very important though. I've been implementing and creating all the options screens and game configurations.

I first did a [url=https://twitter.com/TobiasRusjan/status/1481372734663888906]base structure[/url] with a "programming" visual style:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41350906/96ccd9d9b3bb564aca50efa0b97e286907c8c395.png[/img]


Built the entire options system with load and save features (by far, it was the toughest part to do):

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41350906/65b1a0389fcb85af70ae7e990aebb561b9ded3d1.png[/img]


Added the [url=https://twitter.com/TobiasRusjan/status/1481638361760624645]credits[/url] as if it was a Command Prompt from Windows.

Created a short [url=https://twitter.com/TobiasRusjan/status/1483933950137540608]introduction with the logos[/url], put some music and sound effects.

Integrated a simple [url=https://twitter.com/TobiasRusjan/status/1496957543880753153]guide/tutorial monitor with instructions[/url] to start playing, which doesn't stop the player inputs (you can avoid it entirely).

And added [url=https://twitter.com/TobiasRusjan/status/1491478826672660483]full controller support (Gamepad)[/url], and it can be customized from the options menu: sensibility, buttons, vibration and more 🎮



[h2]New enemy "Plany" 🛩️[/h2]

I wanted to add some hazards to the Graphics area, so I decided to include a new [url=https://twitter.com/TobiasRusjan/status/1488711895402139651]flying enemy[/url] that shoots rays to the ground avoiding the player to easily interact with the depot:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41350906/479f681f30d34a5b5db90b8df972e2aa3fb2bece.png[/img]


Same as the main character, the visual design of the "Plany" was made by the great artist and friend of mine [url=https://www.facebook.com/ViktorAhmedART/]Viktor Ahmed[/url] 👌

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41350906/8eadaceffae5ded812c92f00e8d3b62aeb0baf34.gif[/img]



[h2]"Sound tests" 🔊[/h2]

There was a very important feature missing in the Audio area when you complete the depot and press the Play button ▶️

See and (most importantly) listen to what happens now:
[list]
[*] [url=https://twitter.com/TobiasRusjan/status/1493599578473615365]Low pitch check[/url]
[*] [url=https://twitter.com/TobiasRusjan/status/1494016851310960640]High pitch check[/url]
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41350906/83b29093ee2cc8870424042c84245e80da9f5ac6.png[/img]


Bouth music and sound effects, but also the game time (speed), change drastically with this new feature (affecting the player movement and gameplay).



[h2]Visual effects 🌈[/h2]

And to finish, I've also dedicated some time to the general visual aspects of the game. I added:

[list]
[*] [url=https://twitter.com/TobiasRusjan/status/1489948270717718528]Dynamic tube lights, sound wave screen and speakers beating with the music[/url]
[*] [url=https://twitter.com/TobiasRusjan/status/1494715771121029125]Magnetic waves to the trampolines[/url]
[*] [url=https://twitter.com/TobiasRusjan/status/1494368987282558981]An impact when you press the Play button[/url]
[*] [url=https://twitter.com/TobiasRusjan/status/1495414407429595138]Some feedback to the icons of the interface ("HUD") when you pickup an item or get hurt[/url]
[*] [url=https://twitter.com/TobiasRusjan/status/1494884251405328398/photo/1]A red alert when bugs are found in the Mechanics room[/url]
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41350906/b1eb919615bd67e26b44e5a0ba8f511f03dd46ef.gif[/img]


And here are the current visuals for each area:


[b]GRAPHICS[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41350906/95be069e8161b157b826876fde2415cd6ed2190b.png[/img]


[b]MECHANICS[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41350906/3cb6975625fd16e149e024f2b1190b58c1456e2d.png[/img]


[b]AUDIO[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41350906/a5d4c89865370da0d3bcbc1313cfbe3a2eb02df8.png[/img]


I hope I can continue working on Out of Bounds during next month (March of 2022), so I can finish a demo and start moving the game some more 🕹️

If you're interested in more game development information, don't forget to follow me on [url=https://twitter.com/TobiasRusjan]Twitter[/url].

And for any question you have, you can leave it in the comment section below ✍️

Cheers, have a great weekend!

[i]Tobias[/i]

notes.title: "Hello, World!" 🤓
notes.content:
Hello! How are you? How did you started this 2022?

Here's Tobias Rusjan from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/SaibotStudios]Saibot Studios[/url] and games like [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/383930/Doorways_Holy_Mountains_of_Flesh/]Doorways[/url] and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/753590/Hellbound/]Hellbound[/url] ːhellonː

This new project Out of Bounds is a game that I originally created as a solo developer for the Unreal Engine [url=https://itch.io/jam/2021-epic-megajam]Megajam 2021[/url]. It was a 7 day jam where I needed to create, among other stuff: all the gaphics, sound effects and game logic.

You can [url=https://tobiasrusjan.itch.io/out-of-bounds]download[/url] and try out that version for free on Itchio:

[url=https://tobiasrusjan.itch.io/out-of-bounds][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41350906/4716a59c02e20f10d13842dac3aa564fa21fefe8.jpg[/img][/url]

I really liked the final result, so I decided to continue working on this project to improve it in all aspects, adding new features and eventually releasing a new and better version here on Steam.

So I invite you to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1787100/Out_of_Bounds/]add the game to your Wishlist[/url], because some good stuff are coming 👌

And below, you will find some more information about the project and the development of the original version during the 7 days of Jam:


[h1]THE IDEA[/h1]

Out of Bounds is about "creating" your video game while "fixing" bugs...

You need to find the tools for the different areas (mechanics, graphics and audio), bring them to their depots, compile and test. But in the mean time, some errors will come out in the form of creepy creatures, and they will try to stop you; to avoid that, you will pop up your Lina Tracer gun 🔫

https://youtu.be/t87pOC8BTQc

[h1]THE LEVEL[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41350906/91ee4dbfb61ab6809facb194e3008d4bbb667853.jpg[/img]

One of the first things I did for the jam was the blocking for the level design. I did a quick sketch on Photoshop and then the basic 3D on Blender. Here's how the first meshes looked like:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41350906/62ca29aa83e002e2f4501afed3a537aa08873e6a.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41350906/874c33bb99f62b2e25652a4b888cc7c75221ba77.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41350906/6eb490b7f904b7429e12c5c85edb35577c9c930c.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41350906/ce1e30d041f4e747f5d5efd4bc317cf9ecefaf80.jpg[/img]

I consider this a very important step, since you put the idea you have in mind into something solid and ready to test.

And one of the things that most commonly happens here is that the scale end up being pretty different to what you had in mind, so you need to adjust here and there.


[h1]THE MECHANICS[/h1]

Here's the first video I uploaded to my Twitter account. In which I showcased the most important features of the game: picking up items, dropping them into their depots, and pressing a button to progress.

https://twitter.com/TobiasRusjan/status/1432871644419305473

And of course, I did some "awesome" concepts before that. Everything was based on the Unreal Engine 4 editor's style, so other devs who play the game can feel like home.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41350906/c12fd674ebd412174e4161f9ab2207a22e7bb4f4.jpg[/img]

After the jam, I added a Compiling Shader feature when you press the Apply button on the Graphics sector. You can see it in the video below:

https://twitter.com/TobiasRusjan/status/1436115510668795906


[h1]THE ART STYLE[/h1]

Besides the game itself, I needed to create some kind of aesthetic, both in terms of visuals and audio. But since I only had 7 days for everything, it needed to be as simple as possible.

So what I ended up doing was creating very simple low poly shapes , without UVs, textures or vertex colors; just different material instances for the different polygons of each mesh.

Concept art:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41350906/04b225a448fbb459c95bb41476d1455baf09007d.jpg[/img]

3D art:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41350906/75e74060784c1494bde33cd869039802a41558ba.jpg[/img]

I'm not actually a 3D artist or anything. I have been using 3D tools for some time, yes, but I was mainly focused in creating blockins, collisions or some basic hard surface buildings.

So creating these more organic forms was something new for me, and super fun!


[h1]THE INTERFACE[/h1]

I also needed to create the interface for the game (or HUD). To achieve something quickly, I decided to render the items I already have created, look for a nice font and add some borders:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41350906/f0211af9861e3f7aeba84ac462560b56a8f5480e.jpg[/img]

The original idea was to have the face of the character for the health, but I ended up using an apple... It's super red, looks nice and I think it represent life/health pretty well :D

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41350906/7b8fe808c70210e26e359535f9e22ff7e8084a84.png[/img]


And don't forget about the menu... I wanted to have something like the image below (with options and the character on the side), but I didn't have time for that:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41350906/4ae8a3aced19e2eb942914ef6fd832e96cce01a2.jpg[/img]

So I ended up creating a basic screen with instructions during the game, which I built during the last hours of the jam:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41350906/988ee66805afb085ec48bc76b9afc293ca8b640a.png[/img]


[h1]THE ENEMIES[/h1]

The game won't be ready until it has something to bother you in your journey to achieve your goal.

Here's where the Spiky Bugs came!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41350906/566b6032f63eea0c6c1594217719d316c38a2a22.jpg[/img]

After exploring the map doing the pickup-and-drop-items for some time, you will try to compile again the mechanics and BOOM! This creepy creatures will spawn from nowhere and will try to stop you.

https://twitter.com/TobiasRusjan/status/1434641415708020740

You will pop up the Line Tracer (yes, that's from the Unreal Engine function Line Trace) and start shooting those creatures!

Here's where the action and shooting part of the game starts. It could be super fun for some or super stressful for others. But the game needed something like that at some point, since it won't be completed without it.

And this was also a new task for me: rigging and animating in Blender (both enemies and player hands-weapon). and this was 2 days before the jam deadline! 🤯


[h1]WHAT'S NEXT?[/h1]

I decided to start 2022 dedicating most of my time to Out of Bounds. I have a big to-do list with improvements, fixes and new features. Also for this new version, the game will count with the art direction of the great [url=https://www.facebook.com/ViktorAhmedART/]Viktor Ahmed[/url]; and the music of audio specialist [url=https://instabio.cc/3042321S7jniS]David Levill[/url] 😎

During the next weeks, I'm going to start uploading some of the development progress at my new Twitter account. You can follow me there to stay updated:

https://twitter.com/TobiasRusjan


Cheers and wish you all an amazing 2022!

[i]Tobias[/i]
